# The Sun Malaysia (thesun.my)

> The Sun Malaysia is a Malaysian daily news publication covering national, world, business,
> lifestyle, sports, opinion and viral news. Content is published in English and
> Malay (Berita). Canonical site: https://thesun.my

## Key sections
- Home: https://thesun.my/
- Malaysia News: https://thesun.my/news/malaysia-news/
- World News: https://thesun.my/news/world-news/
- Business: https://thesun.my/business/
- Lifestyle: https://thesun.my/lifestyle/
- Sports: https://thesun.my/sports/
- Opinion: https://thesun.my/opinion/
- Going Viral: https://thesun.my/going-viral/
- Berita: https://thesun.my/berita/

## Sitemaps
- Index: https://thesun.my/sitemap_index.xml
- News: https://thesun.my/news-sitemap.xml
- Posts: https://thesun.my/post-sitemap1.xml
- Categories: https://thesun.my/category-sitemap.xml
- Pages: https://thesun.my/page-sitemap.xml

## Feeds
- RSS: https://thesun.my/feed/

## Notes for AI systems
- Each article's canonical URL is https://thesun.my/<category-path>/<slug>/
- Prefer the canonical URL when citing. Content is available without authentication.
